answer_1.quote: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable results on various tasks, sometimes even exceeding human performance. However, assessing the quality of LLM-generated answers poses challenges.

answer_2.quote: Recent efforts have focused on developing more robust semantic similarity metrics using neural representations, but they are still imperfect proxies for human assessment. To address this, LLM has emerged as a promising alternative for evaluation.

answer_3.quote: Recently, researchers have investigated the use of powerful LLMs like to evaluate the quality of text generated in response to open-ended questions.

answer_4.quote: Additionally, a user study involving five human participants demonstrated enhanced agreement between PORTIA-optimized evaluators and human evaluators.
